title: Finite separable field extensions and finite continuous G-sets
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], K^sep a separable closure [def-pd-separable-closure], and G = Gal(K^sep/K) with its Krull topology. For every finite separable extension L/K (finite and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]), the set Hom_K(Spec K^sep, Spec L) is a finite transitive discrete continuous G-set. For every K-embedding sigma: L \to K^sep, the stabilizer of the corresponding point is Gal(K^sep/sigma(L)). Conversely, every finite transitive discrete continuous G-set is isomorphic to one of this form. Moreover, for finite separable extensions L/K and L'/K, the map Hom_K(Spec L, Spec L') \to Hom_G(Hom_K(Spec K^sep, Spec L), Hom_K(Spec K^sep, Spec L')) induced by precomposition with geometric points is a bijection.

proof.text: For finite separable L/K, geometric points are K-algebra embeddings L into Ksep. Mathlib IsSepClosed.lift supplies an embedding, and AlgHom.fintype supplies finiteness. Given embeddings sigma and tau, compose sigma.equivFieldRange.symm with tau.equivFieldRange and extend this isomorphism of intermediate fields using AlgEquiv.liftNormal Ksep. Its liftNormal_commutes identity gives g composed with sigma = tau. Normality is inferred from IsSepClosure. This packaged automorphism construction replaces the separate embedding-extension and algebraic-endomorphism-bijectivity leaves. The stabilizer is the fixing subgroup of IntermediateField.map sigma top, proved pointwise. The range is finite-dimensional via sigma.equivFieldRange.toLinearEquiv; IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup_isOpen [lem-exc-etale-finite-subextension-fixing-subgroup-open] makes the stabilizer open.

source.place: Tag 03SF, finite separable field component; Mathlib field-theory declarations supply the extension and openness facts

proof.text: Choose a point y of the nonempty pretransitive G-set Y and let H be its stabilizer, open by the hypothesis. Apply openSubgroup_fixedField_finite_separable [lem-exc-etale-open-subgroup-fixed-field] to construct E = IntermediateField.fixedField H, finite separable over K, with E.fixingSubgroup = H. The embeddings of E are pretransitive by step 1, and the stabilizer of E.val is H. Identify both actions with G/H: the orbit maps on the quotient are well-defined and injective by equality of stabilizers, and surjective by pretransitivity. Their inverse composite is an equivariant equivalence Y with the embeddings of E. The private transitive_actions_equiv helper proves this quotient construction explicitly, using Mathlib MulAction.ofQuotientStabilizer and its injectivity and equivariance lemmas.

source.place: Tag 03QR, finite Galois correspondence discussion: orbit-stabilizer and fixed field

proof.text: Injectivity of precomposition follows by evaluating at an embedding sigma of L and using sigma.injective. For surjectivity, given equivariant phi put tau = phi(sigma). Every automorphism fixing sigma.fieldRange fixes sigma, hence fixes tau by equivariance. InfiniteGalois.fixedField_fixingSubgroup [lem-exc-etale-galois-fixed-field-subgroup], with the Galois instance inferred from IsSepClosure, implies tau takes values in sigma.fieldRange. Define tau prime by AlgHom.codRestrict and f = sigma.equivFieldRange.symm.toAlgHom composed with tau prime. The inverse equivalence identity proves sigma composed with f = tau. Transitivity from step 1 and equivariance give rho composed with f = phi(rho) for every embedding rho, establishing surjectivity.

lean.statement: theorem finite_separable_extension_galois_classification (K : Type u) (Ksep : Type v) [Field K] [Field Ksep] [Algebra K Ksep] [IsSepClosure K Ksep] (L : Type w) (L' : Type w') [Field L] [Field L'] [Algebra K L] [Algebra K L'] [FiniteDimensional K L] [FiniteDimensional K L'] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L'] : (Nonempty (L →ₐ[K] Ksep) ∧ Finite (L →ₐ[K] Ksep) ∧ (∀ σ τ : L →ₐ[K] Ksep, ∃ g : Gal(Ksep / K), g.toAlgHom.comp σ = τ) ∧ (∀ σ : L →ₐ[K] Ksep, {g : Gal(Ksep / K) | g.toAlgHom.comp σ = σ} = (IntermediateField.map σ ⊤).fixingSubgroup) ∧ (∀ σ : L →ₐ[K] Ksep, IsOpen {g : Gal(Ksep / K) | g.toAlgHom.comp σ = σ})) ∧ (∀ (Y : Type z) [Finite Y] [MulAction (Gal(Ksep / K)) Y], Nonempty Y → MulAction.IsPretransitive (Gal(Ksep / K)) Y → (∀ y : Y, IsOpen {g : Gal(Ksep / K) | g • y = y}) → ∃ E : IntermediateField K Ksep, FiniteDimensional K E ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K E ∧ ∃ e : Y ≃ (E →ₐ[K] Ksep), ∀ (g : Gal(Ksep / K)) (y : Y), e (g • y) = g.toAlgHom.comp (e y)) ∧ Function.Bijective (fun (f : L' →ₐ[K] L) => (⟨fun (σ : L →ₐ[K] Ksep) => σ.comp f, by intro g σ rfl⟩ : {φ : (L →ₐ[K] Ksep) → (L' →ₐ[K] Ksep) // ∀ (g : Gal(Ksep / K)) (σ : L →ₐ[K] Ksep), φ (g.toAlgHom.comp σ) = g.toAlgHom.comp (φ σ)}))
